summary: Diagnostic audit of Σύνολο ERP business back-office (32 pages @1920x800 + @390x844). All pages return HTTP 200, no hydration/console errors observed after warm-up (initial /reports/withholding shows 4 dev-mode warnings that clear on 2nd visit). Money format (1.234,56 €) and date format (dd/MM/yyyy) are correct. Core flows work: login, invoice list, invoice detail (PDF/email dialog opens, myDATA QR shown), /invoices/new form loads with 17 inputs, /customers/new validates required fields (native 'Συμπληρώστε αυτό το πεδίο'), /pos loads 13 product tiles, /accounting 5 tabs render, /settings 16 tabs render + Save button present, /risks 'Λύσε το με AI' dialog opens, /billing plans render (Starter/…), /notifications list renders, /account passkeys section present, /invoice email dialog opens, /reports date pickers present. Issues found: mainly terminology/sidebar–h1 mismatches, one duplicated CTA (/projects), several unreachable sub-routes that respond 404 (/banking/reconcile, /banking/extrait, /banking/import), /reports/withholding is orphan (no nav entry from sidebar or dashboard), /reports/cashflow only reachable from dashboard (not sidebar), and /delivery-notes silently redirects to /invoices (no dedicated page).

ui_bugs.issue: Two 'Νέο έργο' buttons with identical href '/projects/new' rendered in main content (duplicated primary CTA)

Sub-routes /banking/reconcile, /banking/extrait, /banking/import all return 404 'Η σελίδα δεν βρέθηκε'. The audit brief expected banking tabs (extrait/reconcile) and an import dialog. Import CSV dialog exists at /banking (data-testid=import-open-payments) but reconcile/extrait are only accessible per-account via /banking/{accountId}?tab=statement. Global banking tabs are missing.

Route silently 3xx-redirects to /invoices. There is no dedicated delivery-notes page — clicking anywhere expecting a distinct list shows the invoices grid (h1='Παραστατικά') with the 'Δελτία αποστολής' filter active. Sidebar has no entry, discoverable only via filter chip on /invoices.
Orphan page — not linked from the sidebar and not linked from /dashboard. h1='Βεβαιώσεις παρακρατούμενων φόρων'. First visit produces 4 console warnings (Next dev-mode) but clears on next.
Only reachable from /dashboard; no sidebar entry despite being a major report (h1='Ταμειακή ρευστότητα · 90 ημέρες').

integration_issues.issue: First cold visits at 390x844 to /customers, /projects, /expenses returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) and rendered a short (~290 char) body with horizontal overflow (scrollW=590 > innerW=390). Retrying after a short delay all serve 200 with no overflow. Indicates rate-limit is too aggressive during navigation or 429 page itself is not mobile-responsive.

issues: Static error/short-body page overflows viewport at 390px width (scrollWidth=590).

wording_and_ux_inconsistencies.issue: Sidebar 'Συνδρομές & επαναλαμβανόμενα' → h1 'Επαναλαμβανόμενα παραστατικά' on /recurring. 'Συνδρομές' term dropped.
Sidebar 'POS · Ταμείο λιανικής' → h1 'Ταμείο λιανικής (POS)' (order swapped).

Same content and same h1 'Παραστατικά' for both routes; user has no signal that they are on the 'delivery notes' area — only the 'Δελτία αποστολής' filter chip is highlighted. Consider dedicated h1/subtitle when navigating via that route.
Sidebar/H1 use 'Παραστατικά' (all documents) consistently; subtitle and filter chips use 'τιμολόγια, αποδείξεις, πιστωτικά και δελτία αποστολής' — consistent. No inconsistency found.
Unified as 'Έξοδα & Αγορές' in both sidebar and h1. Consistent.

On /mydata, 'Διαβίβαση εκκρεμών' is disabled while 'Συμφωνία διαβιβασμένων' is enabled. Reason for disabled state is not surfaced (no tooltip/copy). Consider adding a hint 'Δεν υπάρχουν εκκρεμή προς διαβίβαση'.

verified_working: /invoices list with correct GR money format (1.234,56 €) and dd/MM/yyyy dates
/invoices/6e22ac6f… detail: PDF button, 'Αποστολή email' opens dialog, myDATA QR URL rendered
/customers/new: submit empty → native validation 'Συμπληρώστε αυτό το πεδίο' fires, aade-lookup-btn present
/accounting: 5 tabs (Ισοζύγιο, Ημερολόγιο, Αποτελέσματα, Ισολογισμός, Λογιστικό σχέδιο) all render
/settings: 16 tabs render (Επιχείρηση, Τιμολόγηση, Εμφάνιση PDF, Σειρές, Πεδία, myDATA, ΑΑΔΕ, Δημόσιο, ΕΛΠ, Γέφυρα, Χρήστες, Λογιστής, API, Εξαγωγή, Email, Ιστορικό) + Αποθήκευση present
/risks 'Λύσε το με AI' opens role=dialog immediately
/billing renders trial state + Starter/Growth/… plan cards
/account renders profile + notifications matrix + passkeys section
/reports has 3 date inputs including 2 native type=date
/banking main page renders with import CSV (data-testid=import-open-payments), Μεταφορά, Λοιπή κίνηση, Νέος λογαριασμός buttons
action_items: Align sidebar labels with page h1: rename sidebar 'Συνδρομές & επαναλαμβανόμενα' or extend h1 on /recurring to include 'Συνδρομές'.
Align 'Έργα & χρόνος' (sidebar) vs 'Έργα & χρονοχρέωση' (h1). Pick one wording.
Standardise 'POS · Ταμείο λιανικής' vs 'Ταμείο λιανικής (POS)' — same order in both places.

Fix 404s at /banking/reconcile, /banking/extrait, /banking/import OR remove any (stale) references to them; expose global reconcile/extrait tabs on /banking as the audit brief expects, since currently only per-account tabs exist.
Deduplicate the two 'Νέο έργο' buttons on /projects — keep a single primary CTA.
/delivery-notes: either render a distinct page (dedicated h1/subtitle 'Δελτία αποστολής') or add sidebar entry for discoverability, since currently it redirects to /invoices with identical h1.
Add sidebar entries (or expose from parent /reports) for /reports/cashflow and /reports/withholding — both are otherwise unreachable from the sidebar.
Explain disabled state of 'Διαβίβαση εκκρεμών' on /mydata with a tooltip/inline copy ('Δεν υπάρχουν εκκρεμή').

Make the 429 rate-limit response page mobile-responsive (avoid horizontal overflow at 390px) or increase the mobile-first-load rate window; users hitting /customers, /projects, /expenses on cold cache at 390x844 see a broken minimal page.
critical_code_review_comments: app-sidebar.tsx labels drift from page h1s (recurring/projects/pos). Consider a single labels.ts source of truth used by both sidebar and page headers.
Missing sidebar entries for /reports/cashflow, /reports/withholding, /delivery-notes create orphan routes despite being real, functional pages.
/banking/{reconcile,extrait,import} responding 404 suggests removed sub-routes; ensure no stale links point at them (grep the codebase).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all pages 200/renderable; issues are cosmetic/wording/nav-discovery, one duplicated CTA, three 404 sub-routes)

seed_data_creation: none — diagnostic only, no writes performed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnostic-only audit. All 32 pages listed by E1 open successfully. Watch for the following after fixes: (a) /banking sub-tabs (reconcile/extrait/import) if implemented globally; (b) sidebar↔h1 label unification; (c) mobile cold-load rate-limit at 390x844 producing horizontally-overflowing 429 body on /customers,/projects,/expenses; (d) orphan reports pages (/reports/cashflow, /reports/withholding) and /delivery-notes redirect. Do not use forgot-password/reset — this is a demo tenant with mocked myDATA.
